result.topic_en: A heavily revised draft of an introductory historical passage, apparently for Riemann's paper on functions representable by the Gauss series. It cites Euler (Acta Acad. Petr. T. XII p. 58, 3 Sept 1778), later treatment of the relation (Pfaff, Crelle's Journal Bd. II), transformations of the series, Art. 20, and remarks that the unfamiliar approach yields the earlier results almost without calculation.
